interruption_exercise.signal: SIGINT to own campaign parent while GEMM compilation was in progress
interruption_exercise.observed: Completed pipeline cell reused; cancelled compiler work restarted; raw cancelled receipt and ledger event preserved.

unexpected_recovery.error: Broken pipe after the long attached output connection closed
unexpected_recovery.response: Resumed with nohup inside the VM and a persistent console.log; failed baseline rerun, prior terminal work reused.

limitations: Per-profile winners are a portfolio, not one general kernel or a complete suite confirmation.
GEMM profiles are cold single invocation; reusable-state correctness remains separate research.
Program-object memory is not full-wafer SRAM, area or energy.
Git capture was unknown in some VM receipts; source, profile, SDK and evaluator hashes remain recorded. No historical field was backfilled.
Unsigned local journal; raw numerical data and SDK binaries remain ignored local artifacts.
